|lore=Luke had a falling out with his estranged father.
|joke="Falling out" puns on Luke's fall from Cloud City after his duel with Darth Vader. The lore turns it into a family quarrel, but Luke really falls, to what would have been his death, after a duel to the death in which he loses a hand: far more than a quarrel. In game terms, father and son have just fought an [[Epic Duel]], the card the game uses for such lightsaber fights, not had a quarrel.<ref name="film-esb">''The Empire Strikes Back'' (film), directed by Irvin Kershner, 20th Century Fox, 1980.</ref> See [[Jokes#Fall Of The Legend|Jokes]].
|game_text=If you just lost a character during a battle or duel at a Cloud City site, use 2 Force to relocate that character to Weather Vane instead of your Lost Pile. OR Search your Reserve Deck, take one Weather Vane into hand and reshuffle.
